Vermin are creatures who operate on instinct, driven by simple needs such as food and reproduction. Most vermin attack only when hungry or threatened. Vermin are always neutral. Vermin are not governed by a human sense of morality. Vermin are mindless. Vermin generally possess no treasure. For those that do, this treasure consists of possessions formerly owned by a creature that the monster has killed. This type includes insects, arachnids, other arthropods, worms, and similar invertebrates. Some animals like rats and mice are types of vermin.

Venture Bay is a harbor located in the small southwestern coastal area of Grizzly Hills, Northrend. The harbor is one of the few harbors Grizzly Hills has being used by the Venture Company, until the war against the Lich King, where it became a center of conflict between Alliance and Horde over its control. Scouts from the Westfall Brigade Encampment for the Alliance and Conquest Hold for the Horde were engaged in constant battle. Following the war against the Jailer, the harbor was once again under the control of the Venture Company, using it as a base for mining and clear-cutting operations. Verana was the right hand and friend of Alleria Windrunner during the Alliance Expedition's incursion against Ner'zhul and the united orc clans. On the eve of the crossing through the Dark Portal, Alleria came to Verana and asked of her to do her a great service. Alleria explained that it was evident that there was a great risk that she might die in her campaign, and wanted Verana to deliver pendants to Sylvanas and Vereesa. Verana promised to keep them instead, awaiting Alleria's return so that she could give them to the sisters herself. With that, she departed for Quel'Thalas. Vern is a rare crocolisk in a sealed off section of Dalaran underneath the Black Market section of the Underbelly. He can be seen through grates on the floor when entering the Underbelly from the entrance near Krasus' Landing, but normally he cannot be reached or interacted with. Although he can be seen through the floor and with Track Beasts, he cannot be targeted by any means other than typing '/target vern'.

Verlok Stand, as called Verlok Village, is a stone trogg village just north of the Crimson Expanse on the upper shelf in Deepholm. The entrance into the Fungal Deep cavern is found just past Ruberick on the bottom area of the village.
